from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,difflib
ROOT=Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall");D=Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round248-p6-t2-writer-start-condition-synchronization-20261015")
def pin(p,b=None):
 b=p.read_bytes() if b is None else b
 return dict(path=str(p),bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
def save(p,v):
 b=v if type(v)is bytes else (json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
 p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 with p.open('xb') as h:assert h.write(b)==len(b)
 assert p.read_bytes()==b
 return pin(p,b)
plan=json.loads((D/'plan.json').read_bytes());o=json.loads(Path(plan['inputs']['observation']['path']).read_bytes());manifest=json.loads((D/'implementation/prepared-sources.json').read_bytes())
fixture=Path(plan['scope']['modified_existing'][0]);before=D/'implementation/before/test_local_public_writer_binding_race.py'
old=before.read_bytes();after=fixture.read_bytes();delta=plan['scope']['exact_change']
assert len(old)==delta['before_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()==delta['before_sha256']
assert old.count(delta['before'].encode())==1 and after==old.replace(delta['before'].encode(),delta['after'].encode(),1)
assert len(after)==16525 and hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()=='106fdeaaa0ff47cb0584fa6f79e1a0e8afef82bc58622b618717cd88a6038e14'
current_sources=[]
for row in o['current_sources']:
 p=Path(row['original']['path']);actual=pin(p)
 if p!=fixture:assert actual=={k:row['original'][k] for k in ['path','bytes','sha256']}
 current_sources.append(actual)
assert len(current_sources)==27
for row in o['protected']:assert pin(Path(row['path']))=={k:row[k] for k in ['path','bytes','sha256']}
assert len(o['protected'])==211
scripts=[];script_diff=''
for row in manifest['sources']:
 p=Path(row['target']);candidate=Path(row['candidate']['path']);reference=Path(row['reference']['path'])
 raw=p.read_bytes();assert raw==candidate.read_bytes()
 assert pin(candidate)==row['candidate'] and pin(reference)==row['reference']
 scripts.append({**pin(p,raw),'lines':len(raw.splitlines()),'base64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode(),'candidate':row['candidate'],'reference':row['reference']})
 script_diff+=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(reference.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True),raw.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile=str(reference),tofile=str(p)))
roles=[]
for name in ['command-ledger.json','root-command-ledger.json']:
 p=D/name;b=p.read_bytes();r=json.loads(b)
 assert set(r['commands'])=={'baseline','ruff','red'}
 assert all(v['state']=='HELD' and v['used']==0 and v['remaining']==1 for v in r['commands'].values())
 roles.append({**pin(p,b),'base64':base64.b64encode(b).decode()})
after_pin=save(D/'implementation/after/test_local_public_writer_binding_race.py',after)
fixture_diff=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),after.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile=str(before),tofile=str(fixture))).encode()
diff_pin=save(D/'implementation/limited.diff',fixture_diff)
script_diff_pin=save(D/'implementation/script-limited.diff',script_diff.encode())
native=[pin(D/'implementation'/name) for name in ['actual-fixture-native-tool-return.json','actual-prepare-native-tool-return.json','actual-runner-native-tool-return.json']]
